review_output: {"summary":"I found no blocker in the supplied code. Lock order, re-resolving after waits, and the final auth recheck look right. The three findings: unlimited sessions per admission (MAJOR), an exported static-context path that skips runtime checks (MINOR), and timestamp precision that could falsely reject evidence (MINOR, low confidence).","findings":[{"area":"Abuse / metric integrity","file":"src/lib/live-metric-session.ts","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.55,"issue":"No cap on open sessions per admission or registration. Each new requestId creates a new LiveMetricSession row.","evidence":"sessionId hashes the client requestId. Locking the admission FOR UPDATE only serializes requests. With no count or close-previous check, one credential can mint 120 sessions/min per IP, limited only by the IP rate limit.","impact":"One viewer can grow rows without limit and run parallel sessions. Watch time may be inflated if later aggregation counts per session instead of per registration.","recommended_fix":"While holding the admission lock, count open unexpired sessions for the admission. Reject or close the oldest past a small limit, and enforce it with a DB constraint or index.","required_test":"Issue N+1 sessions with distinct requestIds for one admission. Expect a rejection or the oldest session closed. A retry with the same requestId stays idempotent."},{"area":"Version selection bypass","file":"src/lib/live-metric-session.ts","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.6,"issue":"The exported static MetricSessionContext path skips runtime state, mode/fingerprint matching, video readiness and the re-resolve after blocking waits.","evidence":"If contextSource is not a function, SQL checks only that the version is enabled and unexpired and that videoId IS NOT DISTINCT FROM. The refresh block runs only when typeof contextSource === 'function'.","impact":"A future caller could issue live-mode sessions during replay or after playback ends, or against a stale fingerprint. The null-videoId join could also match.","recommended_fix":"Accept only a resolver function. Alternatively, check mode, fingerprint and runtime in SQL and require l.\"videoId\" IS NOT NULL.","required_test":"Pass a static context for an enabled replay version while the Live is playing. Expect not_authorized. Also expect not_authorized for a Live with a null videoId."},{"area":"Evidence timestamp precision","file":"src/lib/live-metric-session.ts","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.4,"issue":"verifiedAt goes through a JS Date (millisecond precision) before being inserted into LiveMetricRegistration. Any database-side equality check against FormSubmission.verifiedAt could fail.","evidence":"source.verifiedAt is read from f.\"verifiedAt\" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' and then bound as a ${source.verifiedAt} parameter. Postgres keeps microseconds, but JS Dates truncate to milliseconds.","impact":"If verifiedAt was written by SQL now() (microsecond precision), a constraint or trigger comparing exact values returns evidence_rejected, and the viewer is permanently refused a session for that version.","recommended_fix":"Use INSERT ... SELECT f.\"verifiedAt\" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' FROM \"FormSubmission\" f, and compare inside SQL rather than through JS Date round-trips.","required_test":"Set verifiedAt to a value with non-zero microseconds through raw SQL. Issue a session and expect success. Replay it and expect the same registration and session."}]}
